New regex: `^(?P<marker>#{1,6})[ \t]+(?P<text>.*?)(?:(?<=[ \t])#+)?[ \t]*$`

The closing group is `(?:(?<=[ \t])#+)?`, which requires a lookbehind: the character immediately before the closing `#+` run must be a space or tab. So attached hashes (no preceding space) won't match the closing group, and will remain within text.
